note: Real scam messages quoted on official pages (FTC, DOL, IOM, Scamwatch, Hong Kong Police ADCC, UK Take Five). Where a page quoted fragments of an ad or script, the fragments are joined into one message and the item says so in 'note'. 'Wrong number' openers such as 'hi, how are you?' are excluded: a greeting alone is not something any check should flag.

messages.text: Sorry to bother you! I'm Amelia from <redacted>. We recommend a full time/part-time employee job for you, with an hourly salary of 50-200 Australian dollars! Conduct internal testing for some companies' online apps. The work is easy, and you can work 1 to 2 hours each time, and you can obtain a work permit at least 5 times a week. Please note that you must be over 22 years old for this job. If you are over 22 years old and would like to apply for this job, please reply "Yes" or "Interested".
